tokens.name: mm-yellow-500
tokens.usage: Primary Yellow — the main call to action, active navigation indicator, ratings star. Charcoal `mm-charcoal-900` text on it (8.4:1). Never as text on white or canvas (1.7:1).

tokens.name: mm-yellow-600
tokens.usage: Hover / pressed state of `mm-yellow-500` fills. Charcoal text on it (6.8:1).

tokens.name: mm-charcoal-900
tokens.usage: Brand dark: headings, primary text, the sidebar, dark headers and hero panels. White text on it (14.5:1).

tokens.name: mm-charcoal-800
tokens.usage: Raised charcoal: the active nav item background and hover rows on charcoal surfaces. White (11.5:1) or yellow (6.6:1) on it.

tokens.name: mm-white
tokens.usage: Text and icons on charcoal surfaces; the Secondary button fill.

tokens.name: mm-canvas
tokens.usage: Canvas — the app/page background. Keep cards white (`mm-surface`) on it.

tokens.name: mm-surface
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, dialogs and sheets on the canvas.

tokens.name: mm-border
tokens.usage: 1px borders on cards, inputs and dividers. Note: 1.3:1 on white — below the 3:1 UI-boundary floor; inputs always carry a visible label, and the focus state adds `mm-focus`. Kept exact from the source.

tokens.name: mm-text
tokens.usage: Primary text on `mm-surface` and `mm-canvas` (14.5:1 / 13.6:1).

tokens.name: mm-text-muted
tokens.usage: Slate — supporting text, secondary labels, placeholders on `mm-surface` and `mm-canvas` (5.7:1 / 5.3:1).

tokens.name: mm-text-subtle
tokens.usage: Least-emphasis metadata. 3.8:1 on white — passes only for large text (24px+) or non-text marks; do not use for 12–16px copy. Kept exact from the source.

tokens.name: mm-success
tokens.usage: Success / available / in-progress: dots, icons, progress fills. As text: 4.4:1 on white, 4.0:1 on `mm-success-bg` — below AA for small text, so pair the dot with `mm-text` label text.

tokens.name: mm-success-bg
tokens.usage: Background of success chips and banners.

tokens.name: mm-info
tokens.usage: Information status and links on white (5.2:1) and `mm-info-bg` (4.6:1).

tokens.name: mm-info-bg
tokens.usage: Background of information chips and banners.

tokens.name: mm-warning
tokens.usage: Warning / awaiting status dots and icons. 4.1:1 on `mm-warning-bg` — below AA for small text; pair with `mm-text` labels.

tokens.name: mm-warning-bg
tokens.usage: Background of warning chips and banners.

tokens.name: mm-error
tokens.usage: Error status, invalid input borders and icons, the Destructive button fill. White on it is 4.4:1 and error text on white 4.4:1 — just under AA for 14px text; kept exact from the source.

tokens.name: mm-error-bg
tokens.usage: Background of error chips and banners.

tokens.name: mm-focus
tokens.usage: Focus border on inputs and the colour of the focus ring (5.2:1 on white).
